summary: Verified removal of cookie-based auth. All 7 backend tests pass and all frontend flows work with Bearer-token-only auth. Zero app-level set-cookie headers on /api/auth/login, /register, /logout, /refresh. CORS preflight returns allow-origin=* WITHOUT allow-credentials. Frontend login stores token in localStorage; /profile, /admin, /register, /logout all accessible. config.js contains no withCredentials.

minor.issue: Refresh flow is effectively unusable: login/register only return access_token in JSON body (no refresh_token). Since cookies were removed and the client never receives a refresh token, calls to /auth/refresh always yield 401 'Invalid token type'. Not a blocker for login, but the endpoint is dead code. Either remove it, or return refresh_token in the login/register JSON so the SPA can call refresh.

action_items: Decide on refresh strategy: either drop /api/auth/refresh endpoint or include refresh_token in login/register response body (never worked via cookie after removal).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1245 lines — should be split into modules (auth, qso, admin, imports) for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

CORS is currently allow_origins=['*'] via CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env; is_wildcard toggles allow_credentials=False which is correct for the current design. In production (Render), if CORS_ORIGINS is set to explicit domains, allow_credentials will flip to True even though the app no longer needs credentialed requests — recommend hard-coding allow_credentials=False since auth is header-based only.
Refresh endpoint code path is dead (see minor issue above).
seed_data_creation: Test registered a throwaway TEST_<uuid>@test.com user via /api/auth/register
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 review items validated. Backend base URL tested: https://radio-memory.preview.emergentagent.com. Tests must be invoked with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set (pytest doesn't auto-load frontend/.env). If deploying, verify Render's CORS_ORIGINS env var still resolves to wildcard OR keep allow_credentials off.
rca of the issue: Original bug: backend set HttpOnly cookies (SameSite=None) on login/register — browsers block cross-origin cookies from Vercel→Render without proper credentials setup. Fix applied: all set_auth_cookies calls removed; get_current_user reads Bearer from Authorization header only; CORSMiddleware now uses allow_credentials=False when wildcard origins. Verified: no app-emitted set-cookie headers on any /api/auth/* endpoint, JWT returned in JSON body, frontend stores it in localStorage and sends via axios interceptor. Login/logout/profile/admin/register all functional in preview env.
